description: Three separate sections, each adding or subtracting a pair of inputs and splitting the result to six outputs

params.text: Chooses whether that section adds its two inputs or subtracts the lower one from the upper one.

inputs.text: The first input of that section; the section's other input is added to it or subtracted from it.
The second input of that section; it is added to the section's other input or subtracted from it.

outputs.text: Carries that section's sum or difference, the same signal on every one of the section's outputs.
